---
title: Issue codes
description: Every code the library can report, generated from the source so it cannot drift.
---

Match on the code, never on the message: the wording is not part of the API, the code is.
Every code is also a static on `IssueCode` in camelCase — `too_small` is
`IssueCode.tooSmall`.

Parameters named in a meaning are in `issue.params`, ready to interpolate into your own
wording.

     Do not edit by hand. -->

### Decoding

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `invalid_escape` | A string escape that is not one: a lone surrogate, a non-hex `\u` digit. `location` is the backslash. "contains an invalid escape sequence". |
| `assayer_conversion_failed` | The value was accepted by the schema but refused by its conversion. |
| `fallback_applied` | Fell back to the declared value. |
| `alias_matched` | Was read from its alias "…". A warning: the field decoded from a `@Key(_:or:)` alias rather than its primary key. Params: `alias`. |
| `invalid_regex_pattern` | The rule's pattern … is not a valid regular expression. Params: `pattern`. |
| `regex_unavailable` | Regular expressions are not available on this platform version. |
| `unknown_variant` | Params: `options`. |
